## 运行与输出

本文件与论文中的六方法比较一致：Ky–Fan（$k=1,3$）、LC、CLX、CZZW 和 WZZ。
保留原有的数据生成方式、设定和各方法随机种子规则。默认运行全部 180 个设定；
论文 Table 4 和 Appendix C 展示的是其中 $m=150$ 的部分结果。
新的运行使用独立输出目录，不会覆盖此前的模拟结果或接续旧版检查点。

本文件独立包含全部模拟代码，仅需 R、`rmarkdown` 和 `knitr`，不读取旧结果、外部 R 脚本或 Zotero 文件。
在 RStudio 打开本文件，点击 **Knit** 即运行正式比较：每个设定重复 `R=1000` 次，
每次使用 `B=1000` 次置换／Gaussian multiplier 重抽样，显著性水平为 0.05。
最多使用 **7 个并行工作进程，每个进程 1 个 BLAS 线程**；`workers` 可改为 1–7。
`R` 控制 Type I error rate 的模拟精度，`B` 控制单次检验的重抽样精度，两者含义不同。

保留 3 组 $(p,m)$、4 种协方差结构、15 个分布配对，共 **180 个设定**。
每个设定都计算 **6 个方法结果**；完整 `summary.csv` 有 **1080 行**。
两种固定阶数的 Ky–Fan 检验共享数据和置换分组；其余方法共享同一批数据，并使用各自的校准方法。
本报告不画图；输出的 Wilson 区间可直接供后续绘图使用。

输出存放于本文件上一级的 `simulation_results/comparison/h0_<运行标识>/`：

| 文件 | 内容 |
|:--|:--|
| `summary.csv` | 每个设定 × 方法的拒绝次数、Type I error rate、MCSE、95% Wilson 区间及失败计数 |
| `replicates.csv` | 每次重复的统计量、p 值、拒绝决策、状态、原因与随机种子 |
| `failed_cells.csv` | 出现计算失败的设定 × 方法；没有失败时只有列名 |
| `scenario_summaries/` | 各设定完成后立即保存的小型汇总 CSV |
| `checkpoints/` | 每 `checkpoint_every` 次重复保存一次的续跑文件，默认 10 次 |
| `configuration.*`, `scenario_grid.csv`, `sessionInfo.txt`, `input_*.Rmd` | 参数、设定表、运行环境与输入代码快照 |

默认 `resume: true`：相同代码、科学参数及 R 版本可继续已有进度，改变进程数不会改变随机种子或生成新实验。
修改 `R`、`B`、种子、方法代码或数据设定后会使用不同输出目录。
内嵌引擎区域的注释与排版也参与代码校验值计算；整理后的代码会自动使用新的运行目录。
不要同时运行两份相同参数的任务；若需要从头运行，可设 `resume: false`，新结果写入新目录。
完整结束时生成 `COMPLETED.txt`；具体计算失败仍以 CSV 中的 `failed` 和 `status` 为准。

首次可先在本文件所在目录用下面命令检查环境（只运行 6 个代表性设定，**不用于评估检验水平**）：

## 数据与方法

每组样本量为 $m$，两组独立、均值为零、协方差同为 $\Sigma$。
保留 $(p,m)=(10,50),(10,150),(40,150)$，其中：

- C1：$\Sigma=I_p$。
- C2：$\Sigma_{ij}=0.5^{|i-j|}$。
- C3：$\Sigma=\operatorname{diag}(4,4,4,4,4,1,\ldots,1)$。
- C4：一个 4 维块与 $(p-4)/2$ 个 2 维块；大小为 $d$ 的块为 $0.4I_d+0.6J_d$。

用对称正定平方根将标准化向量变换为协方差 $\Sigma$。
标准化分布为 N（正态）、T（协方差标准化 $t_8$）、E（指数尺度正态混合）、
G（Gamma 尺度正态混合）和 L（独立标准化 logistic 坐标）：

$$
Z_N=H,\quad Z_T=\sqrt{6/Q}\,H,\quad
Z_E=\sqrt{E}\,H,\quad Z_G=\sqrt{V}\,H,
$$

其中 $H\sim N(0,I_p)$，$Q\sim\chi^2_8$，$E\sim\operatorname{Exp}(1)$，
$V\sim\operatorname{Gamma}(3,\text{scale}=1/3)$；L 的每个坐标为 $(\sqrt3/\pi)L_0$，
$L_0$ 服从标准 logistic 分布。
**T、E、G 对每一个观测向量分别抽取一个新的尺度变量，该观测的所有坐标共用它**。
例如一组 50 个观测会抽 50 个独立的 $Q$；另一组再独立抽取自己的 50 个 $Q$。
所有分布都具有零均值与单位协方差。

配对包含 N–N、T–T、E–E、G–G、L–L，以及五种分布之间全部 10 个不同分布配对。
所有配对均处于协方差原假设下；`exchangeable=TRUE` 标记同分布配对。

| CSV 方法标记 | 实现与校准 |
|:--|:--|
| `KyFan_k1` | 固定 $k=1$ 的 Ky–Fan 范数；平衡随机置换，plus-one 上尾 p 值 |
| `KyFan_k3` | 固定 $k=3$；与 $k=1$ 共用置换分组，不进行数据驱动选阶 |
| `LC` | Li–Chen (2012)，包含均值修正项的完整 $U$ 统计量；标准正态上尾 |
| `CLX` | Cai–Liu–Xia (2013)，标准化协方差元素差的平方最大值；Gumbel 极值校准 |
| `CZZW` | Chang–Zhou–Zhou–Wang (2017)，标准化元素差的绝对最大值；Gaussian multiplier 校准 |
| `WZZ` | Wang–Zhu–Zhang (2024)，偏差修正二次差异；三累积量匹配的平移／缩放卡方校准 |

CZZW 与 WZZ 按作者姓氏首字母命名；LC 与 CLX 沿用原标记。
随机种子内部仍使用历史标记 `Chang`、`Wang`，确保改名不改变随机数序列。

这些设定保留用于统一比较，不意味着它们全部满足每一种方法的充分理论条件。
例如 T、E、G 的公共尺度会引入坐标依赖，$t_8$ 不具有有限八阶矩。
CSV 的 `applicability` 列保留这些解释；所有方法仍在全部设定上实际计算，
超出各方法充分条件的结果用于考察稳健性，不因此获得原定理保证。

## 运行结果

```{r run-comparison, message=TRUE}
grid <- slads_grid(params$profile)
result <- slads_run(grid, R = params$R, B = params$B, alpha = params$alpha, seed = params$seed,
  workers = params$workers, output_root = params$output_root, resume = params$resume, checkpoint_every = params$checkpoint_every,
  input_path = .slads_input_path)
```

本次输出目录：`r result$directory`。
本次完成 `r nrow(grid)` 个设定、`r nrow(result$summary)` 个设定与方法组合，
每个设定重复 `r result$config$R` 次。

```{r summary-preview}
knitr::kable(head(result$summary[c("p", "m", "covariance", "pair", "method", "rejections", "valid",
  "failed", "type1_error_rate", "mcse", "ci_low", "ci_high")], 12), digits = 4, caption = "CSV 预览（前 12 行；完整结果见 summary.csv）")
```

```{r failures-preview}
knitr::kable(aggregate(cbind(attempted, valid, failed) ~ method, data = result$summary, FUN = sum),
  caption = "各方法的计算次数与失败次数")
```

`type1_error_rate`（另有同值列 `rejection_rate`）等于拒绝次数除以重复次数；
`mcse` 为二项 Monte Carlo 标准误，`ci_low`、`ci_high` 为逐设定的 95% Wilson 区间，
即使拒绝次数为零也使用 Wilson 公式。这些区间没有进行多重比较调整。

**计算失败不记作“不拒绝”**。若某个设定与方法组合发生失败，
其主要误差率与区间置为缺失；`conditional_rejection_rate` 和 `conditional_ci_*`
另行给出仅在成功重复中的比例与区间，不能将其混同为完整模拟的 Type I error rate。
失败原因可在 `replicates.csv` 中按 `status != "ok"` 筛选。

## 实现说明与来源

- 置换每次从合并的 $2m$ 个观测中均匀随机选取 $m$ 个，另一组取其补集。
  每次重新计算各组均值与分母为 $m-1$ 的样本协方差。
  两个固定阶数的 p 值均为 $(1+\#\{T_b\ge T_{\rm obs}\})/(B+1)$。
- LC 使用全部二、三、四阶互异指标求和项的代数化简，保留其原始正态校准。
  [Li and Chen (2012), Annals of Statistics](https://doi.org/10.1214/12-AOS993)。
- CLX 与 CZZW 的协方差元素包含对角线，经验协方差采用分母 $m$。
  CZZW 每个观测抽一个 Gaussian multiplier，并在该观测的所有协方差元素间共享它；
  p 值为重抽样统计量大于等于观测值的次数除以 $B$，不套用置换 plus-one 修正。
  [Cai, Liu and Xia (2013), JASA](https://doi.org/10.1080/01621459.2012.758041)，
  [Chang et al. (2017), Biometrics](https://doi.org/10.1111/biom.12552)。
- WZZ 的实现依据作者公开的 [arXiv:2212.12338](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.12338)
  （2022 年手稿，对应 2024 年期刊论文），不是已经逐式核验最终期刊排版的声明。
  保留三累积量匹配的卡方校准；估计累积量不满足正性条件时明确记录失败，
  不截断方差、不取绝对值，也不临时换成其他检验。


## 内嵌代码

下面代码与上面的运行共用同一份定义；HTML 默认折叠，RMD 中可直接查看与修改。

```{r embedded-data, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
# Base-R engine: rows are observations; columns are variables.
# Derive independent streams from fixed tags, never from worker order.
slads_seed <- function(master, ...) {
  key <- paste(..., collapse = "|")
  h <- as.double(master%%2147483646)
  for (v in utf8ToInt(key)) h <- (131 * h + v)%%2147483646
  as.integer(h + 1)
}

slads_set_seed <- function(seed) {
  RNGkind("Mersenne-Twister", "Inversion", "Rejection")
  set.seed(seed)
}

# Covariance structures C1--C4 and the symmetric positive-definite square root.
slads_covariance <- function(p, model = "C1") {
  stopifnot(p >= 5L, p == as.integer(p))
  if (model == "C1")
    return(diag(p))
  if (model == "C2")
    return(0.5^abs(outer(seq_len(p), seq_len(p), "-")))
  if (model == "C3")
    return(diag(c(rep(4, 5), rep(1, p - 5))))
  if (model == "C4") {
    stopifnot(p%%2L == 0L)
    S <- diag(p)
    start <- 1L
    for (d in c(4L, rep(2L, (p - 4L)/2L))) {
      ii <- seq.int(start, length.out = d)
      S[ii, ii] <- 0.4 * diag(d) + 0.6
      start <- start + d
    }
    return(S)
  }
  stop("Unknown covariance model: ", model)
}

slads_sqrt <- function(Sigma) {
  e <- eigen(Sigma, symmetric = TRUE)
  stopifnot(min(e$values) > 0)
  tcrossprod(sweep(e$vectors, 2L, sqrt(e$values), "*"), e$vectors)
}

# Draw standardized observations, then apply the target covariance.
slads_draw <- function(n, law, sqrt_sigma) {
  p <- ncol(sqrt_sigma)
  if (law == "L") Z <- matrix(rlogis(n * p), n, p) * sqrt(3) / pi else {
    Z <- matrix(rnorm(n * p), n, p)
    scale <- switch(law,
      N = rep(1, n), T = sqrt(6 / rchisq(n, 8)),
      E = sqrt(rexp(n)), G = sqrt(rgamma(n, shape = 3, scale = 1 / 3)),
      stop("Unknown standardized law: ", law)
    )
    Z <- Z * scale  # One scale per observation, shared across its coordinates.
  }
  Z %*% sqrt_sigma
}

# Cumulative singular values of a symmetric covariance difference.
kyfan_curve <- function(D) cumsum(sort(abs(eigen(D, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values),
  decreasing = TRUE))
kyfan_permutation <- function(X, Y, ks = c(1L, 3L), B = 1000L, keep_spectra = FALSE, assignments = NULL) {
  stopifnot(is.matrix(X), is.matrix(Y), nrow(X) == nrow(Y), ncol(X) == ncol(Y), all(is.finite(X)),
    all(is.finite(Y)))
  m <- nrow(X)
  p <- ncol(X)
  ks <- sort(unique(as.integer(ks)))
  stopifnot(m > 1L, all(ks >= 1L & ks <= p), B >= 1L)
  Z <- rbind(X, Y)
  # Global centering is algebraically neutral and improves numerical stability.
  Z <- sweep(Z, 2L, colMeans(Z), "-")
  # Reuse pooled sums/cross-products; recompute each permuted group mean.
  total_sum <- colSums(Z)
  total_cross <- crossprod(Z)
  spectrum <- function(ii) {
    A <- Z[ii, , drop = FALSE]
    a <- colSums(A)
    b <- total_sum - a
    AA <- crossprod(A)
    D <- (2 * AA - total_cross - (tcrossprod(a) - tcrossprod(b))/m)/(m - 1)
    kyfan_curve(D)
  }
  observed <- spectrum(seq_len(m))
  if (!is.null(assignments)) {
    stopifnot(is.matrix(assignments), ncol(assignments) == m)
    B <- nrow(assignments)
  }
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, B, if (keep_spectra) p else length(ks))
  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    ii <- if (is.null(assignments)) sample.int(2L * m, m, replace = FALSE) else assignments[b, ]
    if (!is.null(assignments))
      stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(ii), all(ii >= 1 & ii <= 2 * m))
    v <- spectrum(ii)
    out[b, ] <- if (keep_spectra) v else v[ks]
  }
  chosen <- if (keep_spectra) out[, ks, drop = FALSE] else out
  # Include ties in the upper tail. The positive sqrt(m) factor cancels.
  pv <- (1 + colSums(sweep(chosen, 2L, observed[ks], ">=")))/(B + 1)
  names(pv) <- paste0("k", ks)
  list(p_value = pv, statistic = setNames(sqrt(m) * observed[ks], names(pv)), observed = observed,
    perm = sqrt(m) * chosen, perm_spectra = if (keep_spectra) out else NULL, B = B, ks = ks)
}
```

```{r embedded-entrywise, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
# Covariance tests reconstructed from the cited primary papers.
# Base R only. Rows are independent observations; columns are variables.
# No method below relabels observations or substitutes a permutation calibration.
# Sources and implementation choices are documented within this Rmd.

.slads_entry_failure <- function(status, detail) {
  list(p_value = NA_real_, statistic = NA_real_, status = status, detail = detail)
}

.slads_entry_validate <- function(X, Y, min_n = 4L, min_p = 1L) {
  if (!is.matrix(X) || !is.matrix(Y) || !is.numeric(X) || !is.numeric(Y))
    return(.slads_entry_failure("invalid_input", "X and Y must be numeric matrices."))
  if (ncol(X) != ncol(Y) || ncol(X) < min_p || nrow(X) < min_n || nrow(Y) < min_n)
    return(.slads_entry_failure("invalid_dimensions", paste0("Equal column counts, p >= ",
      min_p, ", and each n >= ", min_n, " are required.")))
  if (any(!is.finite(X)) || any(!is.finite(Y)))
    return(.slads_entry_failure("invalid_input", "Non-finite observations are not allowed."))
  NULL
}

# An exact O(n^2 p) reduction of all order-2, order-3, and order-4 sums
# in Li--Chen (2012), Eq. (2.1). H has zero diagonal; r is its row sum.
# Ordered distinct-index triple sum = sum(r^2)-sum(H^2).
# Ordered distinct-index quadruple sum = sum(H)^2-4 sum(r^2)+2 sum(H^2).
# The full U-statistic is translation invariant, so centering is exact here.
# This is NOT the biased first-term-only centered approximation.
.slads_trace_square_u <- function(X, already_centered = FALSE) {
  n <- nrow(X)
  if (n < 4L)
    stop("The exact trace-square U-statistic requires n >= 4.")
  if (!already_centered)
    X <- sweep(X, 2L, colMeans(X), "-")
  H <- tcrossprod(X)
  diag(H) <- 0
  s2 <- sum(H * H)
  r2 <- sum(rowSums(H)^2)
  s3 <- r2 - s2
  s4 <- sum(H)^2 - 4 * r2 + 2 * s2
  s2/(n * (n - 1)) - 2 * s3/(n * (n - 1) * (n - 2)) + s4/(n * (n - 1) * (n - 2) * (n - 3))
}

.slads_li_components <- function(X, Y) {
  n1 <- nrow(X)
  n2 <- nrow(Y)
  Xc <- sweep(X, 2L, colMeans(X), "-")
  Yc <- sweep(Y, 2L, colMeans(Y), "-")
  A1 <- .slads_trace_square_u(Xc, already_centered = TRUE)
  A2 <- .slads_trace_square_u(Yc, already_centered = TRUE)
  # Eq. (2.2), including all mean-correction terms, reduces exactly to
  # tr(cov(X) cov(Y)); use the Gram form to avoid forming p-by-p matrices.
  C12 <- sum(tcrossprod(Xc, Yc)^2)/((n1 - 1) * (n2 - 1))
  list(A1 = A1, A2 = A2, C12 = C12, T = A1 + A2 - 2 * C12, n1 = n1, n2 = n2)
}

method_li <- function(X, Y) {
  invalid <- .slads_entry_validate(X, Y)
  if (!is.null(invalid))
    return(invalid)
  a <- .slads_li_components(X, Y)
  # Cross weights follow Li--Chen (2012), p. 914, and authors' PEtests code.
  sd0 <- 2 * a$A1/a$n2 + 2 * a$A2/a$n1
  if (!is.finite(sd0) || sd0 <= 0 || !is.finite(a$T))
    return(.slads_entry_failure("invalid_null_scale", "Nonpositive or non-finite Li--Chen null standard-error estimate."))
  z <- a$T/sd0
  list(p_value = pnorm(z, lower.tail = FALSE), statistic = z, status = "ok", detail = list(raw_statistic = a$T,
    null_sd = sd0, A1 = a$A1, A2 = a$A2, C12 = a$C12, log_p_value = pnorm(z, lower.tail = FALSE,
      log.p = TRUE), calibration = "upper standard-normal tail; exact U-statistic"))
}

# Residual observation-level covariance products for the upper triangle,
# INCLUDING diagonal entries. Empirical covariance and variance use 1/n,
# as required by Cai--Liu--Xia and Chang et al., not cov()'s 1/(n-1).
.slads_entry_products <- function(X, Y) {
  p <- ncol(X)
  n1 <- nrow(X)
  n2 <- nrow(Y)
  ij <- which(upper.tri(matrix(0, p, p), diag = TRUE), arr.ind = TRUE)
  Xc <- sweep(X, 2L, colMeans(X), "-")
  Yc <- sweep(Y, 2L, colMeans(Y), "-")
  U <- Xc[, ij[, 1L], drop = FALSE] * Xc[, ij[, 2L], drop = FALSE]
  V <- Yc[, ij[, 1L], drop = FALSE] * Yc[, ij[, 2L], drop = FALSE]
  sx <- colMeans(U)
  sy <- colMeans(V)
  U <- sweep(U, 2L, sx, "-")
  V <- sweep(V, 2L, sy, "-")
  denominator <- colMeans(U * U)/n1 + colMeans(V * V)/n2
  if (any(!is.finite(denominator)) || any(denominator <= 0))
    return(.slads_entry_failure("invalid_entry_variance",
      "At least one tested covariance entry has zero or non-finite estimated variance; no entries were silently removed."))
  z <- (sx - sy)/sqrt(denominator)
  if (any(!is.finite(z)))
    return(.slads_entry_failure("invalid_statistic", "Non-finite standardized covariance difference."))
  list(U = U, V = V, denominator = denominator, z = z, n1 = n1, n2 = n2, p = p)
}

.slads_cai_gumbel <- function(M, p) {
  shifted <- M - 4 * log(p) + log(log(p))
  log_a <- -shifted/2 - log(8 * pi)/2
  # log(1-exp(-a)), evaluated stably even for extremely small tail areas.
  log_p <- if (log_a < -36) log_a else log(-expm1(-exp(log_a)))
  list(p_value = exp(log_p), log_p_value = log_p, shifted = shifted)
}

method_cai <- function(X, Y) {
  invalid <- .slads_entry_validate(X, Y, min_n = 2L, min_p = 2L)
  if (!is.null(invalid))
    return(invalid)
  a <- .slads_entry_products(X, Y)
  if (!is.null(a$status))
    return(a)
  M <- max(a$z^2)
  g <- .slads_cai_gumbel(M, a$p)
  list(p_value = g$p_value, statistic = M, status = "ok", detail = list(centered_statistic = g$shifted,
    log_p_value = g$log_p_value, calibration = "Cai--Liu--Xia asymptotic Gumbel tail"))
}

method_chang <- function(X, Y, B = 999L, mc_plus_one = FALSE, bootstrap_batch = 200L) {
  invalid <- .slads_entry_validate(X, Y, min_n = 2L, min_p = 2L)
  if (!is.null(invalid))
    return(invalid)
  if (length(B) != 1L || !is.finite(B) || B < 1L || B > .Machine$integer.max || B != floor(B) ||
    length(bootstrap_batch) != 1L || !is.finite(bootstrap_batch) || bootstrap_batch < 1L ||
    bootstrap_batch > .Machine$integer.max || bootstrap_batch != floor(bootstrap_batch))
    return(.slads_entry_failure("invalid_bootstrap_count", "B and bootstrap_batch must be positive finite integers."))
  a <- .slads_entry_products(X, Y)
  if (!is.null(a$status))
    return(a)
  B <- as.integer(B)
  bootstrap_batch <- as.integer(bootstrap_batch)
  observed <- max(abs(a$z))
  # One independent Gaussian multiplier per observation; the SAME multiplier
  # is used across all covariance entries of that observation (essential).
  W <- rbind(a$U/a$n1, -a$V/a$n2)
  W <- sweep(W, 2L, sqrt(a$denominator), "/")
  boot <- numeric(B)
  for (start in seq.int(1L, B, by = bootstrap_batch)) {
    idx <- start:min(B, start + bootstrap_batch - 1L)
    g <- matrix(rnorm((a$n1 + a$n2) * length(idx)), nrow = a$n1 + a$n2)
    values <- crossprod(g, W)
    boot[idx] <- apply(abs(values), 1L, max)
  }
  # The paper's empirical conditional tail is the default. A plus-one
  # numerical convention can be requested explicitly, never silently.
  count <- sum(boot >= observed)
  pv <- if (isTRUE(mc_plus_one)) (count + 1)/(B + 1) else count/B
  list(p_value = pv, statistic = observed, status = "ok", detail = list(B = B, mc_plus_one = isTRUE(mc_plus_one),
    bootstrap_statistics = boot, calibration = "Chang et al. Gaussian multiplier bootstrap"))
}
```

```{r embedded-wang, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
# Wang--Zhu--Zhang: implementation of the public arXiv:2212.12338 manuscript.
.qt_validate <- function(X, Y, min_n = 4L, min_p = 1L) {
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  Y <- as.matrix(Y)
  if (!is.numeric(X) || !is.numeric(Y) || ncol(X) != ncol(Y) || ncol(X) < min_p || nrow(X) <
    min_n || nrow(Y) < min_n || any(!is.finite(X)) || any(!is.finite(Y))) {
    stop("X and Y must be finite numeric matrices with equal columns and adequate sample sizes.")
  }
  list(X = X, Y = Y)
}

.qt_fail <- function(status, detail, statistic = NA_real_, ...) {
  c(list(p_value = NA_real_, statistic = statistic, status = status, detail = detail), list(...))
}

.qt_center_gram <- function(K) {
  sweep(sweep(K, 1L, rowMeans(K), "-"), 2L, colMeans(K), "-") + mean(K)
}

# Efficiently recover traces of the p^2 by p^2 feature covariance matrices
# from n by n Gram matrices: vec(xx')'vec(yy') = (x'y)^2.
.wang_trace_components <- function(X, Y) {
  n1 <- nrow(X)
  n2 <- nrow(Y)
  X <- sweep(X, 2L, colMeans(X), "-")
  Y <- sweep(Y, 2L, colMeans(Y), "-")
  K11 <- tcrossprod(X)^2
  K22 <- tcrossprod(Y)^2
  K12 <- tcrossprod(X, Y)^2
  A <- .qt_center_gram(K11)/(n1 - 1)
  D <- .qt_center_gram(K22)/(n2 - 1)
  B <- .qt_center_gram(K12)/sqrt((n1 - 1) * (n2 - 1))
  a1 <- sum(diag(A))
  d1 <- sum(diag(D))
  list(n1 = n1, n2 = n2, statistic = mean(K11) + mean(K22) - 2 * mean(K12) - a1/n1 - d1/n2,
    a1 = a1, d1 = d1, a2 = sum(A * A), d2 = sum(D * D), ad = sum(B * B), a3 = sum((A %*%
      A) * A), d3 = sum((D %*% D) * D), a2d = sum((A %*% B) * B), ad2 = sum((B %*% D) *
      B))
}

method_wang <- function(X, Y) {
  xy <- .qt_validate(X, Y, min_n = 4L)
  z <- .wang_trace_components(xy$X, xy$Y)
  n1 <- z$n1
  n2 <- z$n2
  est2 <- function(t1, t2, n) {
    (n - 1)^2/((n - 2) * (n + 1)) * (t2 - t1^2/(n - 1))
  }
  est3 <- function(t1, t2, t3, n) {
    (n - 1)^4/((n^2 + n - 6) * (n^2 - 2 * n - 3)) * (t3 - 3 * t1 * t2/(n - 1) + 2 * t1^3/(n -
      1)^2)
  }
  aa <- est2(z$a1, z$a2, n1)
  dd <- est2(z$d1, z$d2, n2)
  aaa <- est3(z$a1, z$a2, z$a3, n1)
  ddd <- est3(z$d1, z$d2, z$d3, n2)
  aad <- (n1 - 1)/((n1 - 2) * (n1 + 1)) * ((n1 - 1) * z$a2d - z$ad * z$a1)
  add <- (n2 - 1)/((n2 - 2) * (n2 + 1)) * ((n2 - 1) * z$ad2 - z$ad * z$d1)
  K2 <- 2 * (aa/(n1 * (n1 - 1)) + 2 * z$ad/(n1 * n2) + dd/(n2 * (n2 - 1)))
  K3 <- 8 * ((n1 - 2) * aaa/(n1^2 * (n1 - 1)^2) + 3 * aad/(n1^2 * n2) + 3 * add/(n1 * n2^2) +
    (n2 - 2) * ddd/(n2^2 * (n2 - 1)^2))
  if (any(!is.finite(c(K2, K3))) || K2 <= 0 || K3 <= 0) {
    return(.qt_fail("invalid_cumulants", paste0("The published 3-cumulant chi-square approximation requires K2 > 0 and K3 > 0; ",
      "the unmodified estimates do not satisfy this. No truncation or fallback was used."),
      statistic = z$statistic, cumulant2 = K2, cumulant3 = K3))
  }
  beta0 <- -2 * K2^2/K3
  beta1 <- K3/(4 * K2)
  df <- 8 * K2^3/K3^2
  if (any(!is.finite(c(beta0, beta1, df))) || beta1 <= 0 || df <= 0) {
    return(.qt_fail("invalid_approximation", "Non-finite 3-cumulant matching parameters.",
      statistic = z$statistic, cumulant2 = K2, cumulant3 = K3))
  }
  pval <- pchisq((z$statistic - beta0)/beta1, df = df, lower.tail = FALSE)
  list(p_value = pval, statistic = z$statistic, status = "ok",
    detail = "Published three-cumulant matched chi-square normal-reference calibration; sample-mean centering.",
    cumulant2 = K2, cumulant3 = K3, beta0 = beta0, beta1 = beta1, df = df)
}
```

```{r embedded-runner, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
slads_default_methods <- c("KyFan_k1", "KyFan_k3", "LC", "CLX", "CZZW", "WZZ")
# Public labels changed; keep historical RNG tags in both runs and checkpoints.
slads_method_seed_token <- function(method) {
  switch(method, CZZW = "Chang", WZZ = "Wang", method)
}

slads_method_labels <- c(KyFan_k1 = "Ky-Fan (k=1)", KyFan_k3 = "Ky-Fan (k=3)", LC = "Li-Chen (2012)",
  CLX = "Cai-Liu-Xia (2013)", CZZW = "CZZW (2017)", WZZ = "WZZ (2024), normal-reference")
slads_calibrations <- c(KyFan_k1 = "balanced permutation; plus-one upper-tail p", KyFan_k3 = "balanced permutation; plus-one upper-tail p",
  LC = "upper standard-normal tail", CLX = "asymptotic Gumbel tail", CZZW = "Gaussian multiplier bootstrap; empirical upper tail count/B",
  WZZ = "three-cumulant matched shifted/scaled chi-square; 2022 author manuscript")
pair_levels <- c("N-N", "T-T", "E-E", "G-G", "L-L", "N-T", "N-E", "N-G", "N-L", "T-E", "T-G",
  "T-L", "E-G", "E-L", "G-L")

# Fix scenario identifiers and ordering before distributing work.
slads_grid <- function(profile = c("manuscript", "smoke")) {
  profile <- match.arg(profile)
  sizes <- data.frame(p = c(10L, 10L, 40L), m = c(50L, 150L, 150L))
  g <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(sizes)), function(i) {
    z <- expand.grid(covariance = paste0("C", 1:4), pair = pair_levels, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    z$p <- sizes$p[i]
    z$m <- sizes$m[i]
    z
  }))
  g$law_x <- substr(g$pair, 1, 1)
  g$law_y <- substr(g$pair, 3, 3)
  g$exchangeable <- g$law_x == g$law_y
  g$scenario <- with(g, paste0("p", p, "_m", m, "_", covariance, "_", pair))
  if (profile == "smoke") {
    ids <- c("p10_m50_C1_N-N", "p10_m50_C2_N-T", "p10_m50_C3_E-E", "p10_m50_C4_N-L", "p10_m150_C2_G-L",
      "p40_m150_C4_N-N")
    g <- g[match(ids, g$scenario), , drop = FALSE]
  }
  rownames(g) <- NULL
  stopifnot(!anyNA(g), !anyDuplicated(g$scenario))
  g[c("scenario", "p", "m", "covariance", "pair", "law_x", "law_y", "exchangeable")]
}

slads_applicability <- function(method, g) {
  laws <- c(g$law_x, g$law_y)
  if (method %in% c("KyFan_k1", "KyFan_k3"))
    return(if (g$exchangeable) "equal-law exchangeability control" else
      "covariance-only null; finite-sample calibration/stress evaluation")
  if (method == "LC" && any(laws %in% c("T", "E", "G")))
    return("robustness: common-scale dependence is outside the independent-component model; t8 also lacks eighth moments")
  if (method == "CZZW" && "T" %in% laws)
    return("robustness: t8 lacks finite eighth moments required by the polynomial-tail sufficient condition")
  if (method == "WZZ" && "T" %in% laws)
    return("robustness: t8 lacks the raw eighth moments required by the quadratic-feature condition")
  if (method == "CLX")
    return("finite-sample calibration; tail, dependence, fourth-moment and dimension assumptions are not certified by a finite design")
  "finite-sample calibration; remaining moment, spectral and dimension assumptions are not automatically certified"
}

# Failed or invalid p-values have missing decisions, never a non-rejection.
slads_result_row <- function(method, res, seconds, g, alpha) {
  status <- if (is.null(res$status)) "invalid_result" else as.character(res$status)[1]
  pv <- if (is.null(res$p_value)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(res$p_value)[1]
  valid_p <- length(pv) == 1L && is.finite(pv) && pv >= 0 && pv <= 1
  if (status == "ok" && !valid_p)
    status <- "invalid_result"
  decision <- if (status == "ok") pv <= alpha else NA
  detail <- if (is.character(res$detail)) paste(res$detail, collapse = "; ") else ""
  data.frame(
    method = method, p_value = pv,
    statistic = if (is.null(res$statistic)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(res$statistic)[1],
    reject = decision, status = status, detail = detail, seconds = as.numeric(seconds),
    calibration = unname(slads_calibrations[method]),
    applicability = slads_applicability(method, g), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

slads_compare_one <- function(X, Y, g, r, seed, B, alpha) {
  # Both fixed orders use the same observations and permutation assignments.
  slads_set_seed(slads_seed(seed, g$scenario, r, "permutation"))
  started <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  ky <- tryCatch(kyfan_permutation(X, Y, ks = c(1L, 3L), B = B), error = function(e) list(error = conditionMessage(e)))
  ky_seconds <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - started
  rows <- lapply(slads_default_methods, function(method) {
    slads_set_seed(slads_seed(seed, g$scenario, r, slads_method_seed_token(method)))
    started <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
    res <- tryCatch({
      if (method %in% c("KyFan_k1", "KyFan_k3")) {
        if (!is.null(ky$error))
          stop(ky$error)
        k <- if (method == "KyFan_k1") "k1" else "k3"
        list(p_value = unname(ky$p_value[k]), statistic = unname(ky$statistic[k]), status = "ok")
      } else switch(method,
        LC = method_li(X, Y), CLX = method_cai(X, Y),
        CZZW = method_chang(X, Y, B = B, mc_plus_one = FALSE), WZZ = method_wang(X, Y)
      )
    }, error = function(e) list(p_value = NA_real_, statistic = NA_real_, status = "error",
      detail = conditionMessage(e)))
    seconds <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - started
    if (method %in% c("KyFan_k1", "KyFan_k3"))
      seconds <- seconds + ky_seconds
    slads_result_row(method, res, seconds, g, alpha)
  })
  rows <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  for (nm in names(g)) rows[[nm]] <- g[[nm]]
  rows$replicate <- as.integer(r)
  rows$data_seed <- slads_seed(seed, g$scenario, r, "data")
  rows$calibration_seed <- vapply(rows$method, function(method) slads_seed(seed, g$scenario,
    r, if (method %in% c("KyFan_k1", "KyFan_k3")) "permutation" else slads_method_seed_token(method)), integer(1))
  rows
}

slads_wilson <- function(s, n, level = 0.95) {
  if (n < 1L)
    return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  z <- qnorm(1 - (1 - level)/2)
  ph <- s/n
  denominator <- 1 + z * z/n
  middle <- (ph + z * z/(2 * n))/denominator
  half <- z * sqrt(ph * (1 - ph)/n + z * z/(4 * n * n))/denominator
  c(max(0, middle - half), min(1, middle + half))
}

# Main rates require all requested repetitions; valid-only rates are reported separately.
slads_summary <- function(raw, config) {
  groups <- split(raw, interaction(raw$scenario, raw$method, drop = TRUE, lex.order = TRUE))
  out <- do.call(rbind, lapply(groups, function(d) {
    ok <- d$status == "ok" & !is.na(d$reject)
    valid <- sum(ok)
    rejected <- sum(d$reject[ok])
    failed <- nrow(d) - valid
    complete <- nrow(d) == config$R && failed == 0L
    rate <- if (valid > 0L) rejected/valid else NA_real_
    mcse <- if (valid > 0L) sqrt(rate * (1 - rate)/valid) else NA_real_
    ci <- slads_wilson(rejected, valid)
    data.frame(
      d[1, c("scenario", "p", "m", "covariance", "pair", "law_x", "law_y", "exchangeable", "method")],
      method_label = unname(slads_method_labels[d$method[1]]),
      k = if (d$method[1] == "KyFan_k1") 1L else if (d$method[1] == "KyFan_k3") 3L else NA_integer_,
      R = config$R, B = config$B, alpha = config$alpha, seed = config$seed,
      requested = config$R, attempted = nrow(d), valid = valid, failed = failed, rejections = rejected,
      complete = complete,
      type1_error_rate = if (complete) rate else NA_real_,
      rejection_rate = if (complete) rate else NA_real_,
      mcse = if (complete) mcse else NA_real_,
      ci_low = if (complete) ci[1] else NA_real_,
      ci_high = if (complete) ci[2] else NA_real_, confidence_level = 0.95,
      conditional_rejection_rate = rate, conditional_mcse = mcse,
      conditional_ci_low = ci[1], conditional_ci_high = ci[2], calibration = d$calibration[1],
      applicability = d$applicability[1], mean_seconds = mean(d$seconds), stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      row.names = NULL
    )
  }))
  out <- out[order(match(out$scenario, config$grid$scenario), match(out$method, slads_default_methods)),
    , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}

slads_integer <- function(x, name, minimum = 1L, maximum = .Machine$integer.max) {
  if (length(x) != 1L || !is.numeric(x) || !is.finite(x) || x != floor(x) || x < minimum ||
    x > maximum)
    stop(name, " must be an integer in [", minimum, ", ", maximum, "].")
  as.integer(x)
}

slads_hash <- function(x) {
  f <- tempfile()
  on.exit(unlink(f))
  saveRDS(x, f, version = 2)
  unname(tools::md5sum(f))
}

slads_code_hash <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  a <- which(lines == "<!-- slads-engine-start -->")
  b <- which(lines == "<!-- slads-engine-end -->")
  if (length(a) != 1L || length(b) != 1L || a >= b)
    stop("Embedded engine markers are missing.")
  slads_hash(lines[seq.int(a + 1L, b - 1L)])
}

# Write temporary files beside their targets, then commit by renaming.
slads_write_rds <- function(x, path) {
  tmp <- tempfile(pattern = ".checkpoint-", tmpdir = dirname(path))
  on.exit(unlink(tmp))
  saveRDS(x, tmp, version = 2)
  if (!file.rename(tmp, path))
    stop("Cannot commit checkpoint: ", path)
}

slads_write_csv <- function(x, path) {
  tmp <- tempfile(pattern = ".csv-", tmpdir = dirname(path))
  on.exit(unlink(tmp))
  write.csv(x, tmp, row.names = FALSE, na = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
  if (!file.rename(tmp, path))
    stop("Cannot commit CSV: ", path)
}

# Validate scenario, RNG streams and decisions before resuming a checkpoint.
slads_validate_checkpoint <- function(cp, g, config, signature, path) {
  bad <- function(message) stop("Invalid checkpoint ", path, ": ", message)
  if (!is.list(cp) || !identical(cp$signature, signature) || !identical(cp$scenario, g$scenario))
    bad("configuration or scenario mismatch; do not mix output directories.")
  if (!is.list(cp$repetitions) || length(cp$repetitions) > config$R)
    bad("invalid repetition count.")
  for (r in seq_along(cp$repetitions)) {
    d <- cp$repetitions[[r]]
    required <- c("method", "replicate", "scenario", "data_seed", "calibration_seed", "p_value",
      "reject", "status", "statistic", "detail", "seconds", "calibration", "applicability",
      names(g))
    if (!is.data.frame(d) || !all(required %in% names(d)) || nrow(d) != length(slads_default_methods) ||
      !identical(d$method, slads_default_methods))
      bad(paste("incomplete method rows at repetition", r))
    if (anyNA(d[c("replicate", "data_seed", "calibration_seed", "status")]) || any(d$replicate !=
      r) || any(d$data_seed != slads_seed(config$seed, g$scenario, r, "data")))
      bad(paste("repetition or seed mismatch at", r))
    for (nm in names(g)) if (anyNA(d[[nm]]) || any(d[[nm]] != g[[nm]]))
      bad(paste("scenario field", nm, "mismatch"))
    expected <- vapply(d$method, function(method) slads_seed(config$seed, g$scenario, r,
      if (method %in% c("KyFan_k1", "KyFan_k3")) "permutation" else slads_method_seed_token(method)), integer(1))
    if (!identical(unname(d$calibration_seed), unname(expected)))
      bad("calibration seed mismatch")
    ok <- d$status == "ok"
    if (any(ok & (!is.finite(d$p_value) | d$p_value < 0 | d$p_value > 1 | is.na(d$reject))) ||
      any(!ok & !is.na(d$reject)) || any(d$reject[ok] != (d$p_value[ok] <= config$alpha)))
      bad("inconsistent p-value/rejection/status")
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

slads_worker <- function(i, grid, config, signature, directory, resume, checkpoint_every) {
  g <- grid[i, , drop = FALSE]
  path <- file.path(directory, "checkpoints", paste0(g$scenario, ".rds"))
  cp <- list(signature = signature, scenario = g$scenario, repetitions = list())
  if (resume && file.exists(path)) {
    cp <- tryCatch(readRDS(path), error = function(e) stop("Cannot read checkpoint ", path,
      ": ", conditionMessage(e)))
    slads_validate_checkpoint(cp, g, config, signature, path)
  }
  done <- cp$repetitions
  root <- slads_sqrt(slads_covariance(g$p, g$covariance))
  if (length(done) < config$R)
    for (r in seq.int(length(done) + 1L, config$R)) {
      slads_set_seed(slads_seed(config$seed, g$scenario, r, "data"))
      X <- slads_draw(g$m, g$law_x, root)
      Y <- slads_draw(g$m, g$law_y, root)
      done[[r]] <- slads_compare_one(X, Y, g, r, config$seed, config$B, config$alpha)
      if (r%%checkpoint_every == 0L || r == config$R) {
        cp$repetitions <- done
        slads_write_rds(cp, path)
      }
    }
  raw <- do.call(rbind, done)
  rownames(raw) <- NULL
  summary <- slads_summary(raw, config)
  slads_write_csv(summary, file.path(directory, "scenario_summaries", paste0(g$scenario, ".csv")))
  message(g$scenario, ": ", config$R, " repetitions complete; failed evaluations = ", sum(summary$failed))
  list(summary = summary, checkpoint = path)
}

# Stream one scenario at a time to avoid holding all replicate rows in memory.
slads_stream_replicates <- function(paths, file) {
  tmp <- tempfile(pattern = ".replicates-", tmpdir = dirname(file))
  on.exit(unlink(tmp))
  first <- TRUE
  for (path in paths) {
    d <- do.call(rbind, readRDS(path)$repetitions)
    write.table(d, tmp, sep = ",", row.names = FALSE, col.names = first, append = !first,
      quote = TRUE, na = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
    first <- FALSE
  }
  if (!file.rename(tmp, file))
    stop("Cannot commit replicate-level CSV: ", file)
}

slads_run <- function(grid, R = 1000L, B = 1000L, alpha = 0.05, seed = 20260925L, workers = 7L,
  output_root = "../simulation_results/comparison", resume = TRUE, checkpoint_every = 10L,
  input_path = .slads_input_path) {
  R <- slads_integer(R, "R")
  B <- slads_integer(B, "B", minimum = 19L)
  seed <- slads_integer(seed, "seed", minimum = 0L, maximum = 2147483646L)
  workers <- slads_integer(workers, "workers", maximum = 7L)
  checkpoint_every <- slads_integer(checkpoint_every, "checkpoint_every")
  if (length(alpha) != 1L || !is.numeric(alpha) || !is.finite(alpha) || alpha <= 0 || alpha >=
    1)
    stop("alpha must be strictly between zero and one.")
  if (length(resume) != 1L || !is.logical(resume) || is.na(resume))
    stop("resume must be TRUE or FALSE.")
  if (length(output_root) != 1L || !is.character(output_root) || !nzchar(output_root))
    stop("output_root must be a path.")
  if (1/(B + 1) > alpha)
    warning("The plus-one permutation test cannot reject at this alpha with this B.")
  # New R workers inherit these settings before loading their BLAS runtimes.
  Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1", MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1", VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS = "1",
    BLIS_NUM_THREADS = "1", RCPP_PARALLEL_NUM_THREADS = "1")
  if (requireNamespace("RhpcBLASctl", quietly = TRUE)) {
    RhpcBLASctl::blas_set_num_threads(1L)
    RhpcBLASctl::omp_set_num_threads(1L)
  }
  config <- list(engine = "selected-six-methods-v4", grid = grid, R = R, B = B, alpha = as.numeric(alpha),
    seed = seed, methods = slads_default_methods, calibrations = slads_calibrations, code_hash = slads_code_hash(input_path),
    R_version = as.character(getRversion()), platform = R.version$platform, rng = "Mersenne-Twister/Inversion/Rejection")
  signature <- slads_hash(config)
  run_id <- paste0("h0_", substr(signature, 1, 16))
  if (!resume)
    run_id <- paste0(run_id, "_fresh_", basename(tempfile(pattern = "run_")))
  directory <- file.path(output_root, run_id)
  for (path in c(directory, file.path(directory, "checkpoints"), file.path(directory, "scenario_summaries"))) if (!dir.exists(path) &&
    !dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE))
    stop("Cannot create ", path)
  directory <- normalizePath(directory, mustWork = TRUE)
  cfgpath <- file.path(directory, "configuration.rds")
  if (file.exists(cfgpath)) {
    if (!identical(readRDS(cfgpath), config))
      stop("Existing output configuration does not match: ", cfgpath)
  } else slads_write_rds(config, cfgpath)
  # Source snapshots are immutable and keyed by the full source-file hash.
  source_hash <- unname(tools::md5sum(input_path))
  snapshot <- file.path(directory, paste0("input_", source_hash, ".Rmd"))
  if (!file.exists(snapshot) && !file.copy(input_path, snapshot))
    stop("Cannot preserve Rmd input snapshot.")
  slads_write_csv(grid, file.path(directory, "scenario_grid.csv"))
  writeLines(capture.output(str(config)), file.path(directory, "configuration.txt"))
  actual_workers <- min(workers, nrow(grid))
  message("Output: ", directory, "\nScenarios: ", nrow(grid), "; methods: ", length(slads_default_methods),
    "; R=", R, "; B=", B, "; workers=", actual_workers, " (one BLAS thread per worker)")
  common <- list(grid = grid, config = config, signature = signature, directory = directory,
    resume = resume, checkpoint_every = checkpoint_every)
  if (actual_workers > 1L) {
    # PSOCK also works in RStudio and on Windows; no forked GUI process.
    cl <- parallel::makePSOCKcluster(actual_workers, outfile = file.path(directory, "workers.log"))
    on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl), add = TRUE)
    env <- environment(slads_run)
    candidates <- ls(envir = env, all.names = TRUE)
    # Export private helpers too; method seed aliases are required on every worker.
    exported <- candidates[grepl("^(slads_|\\.slads_|kyfan_|method_|\\.qt_|\\.wang_|pair_levels$)",
      candidates)]
    parallel::clusterExport(cl, exported, envir = env)
    answer <- do.call(parallel::parLapplyLB, c(list(cl = cl, X = seq_len(nrow(grid)), fun = slads_worker),
      common))
  } else answer <- do.call(lapply, c(list(X = seq_len(nrow(grid)), FUN = slads_worker), common))
  summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(answer, `[[`, "summary"))
  rownames(summary) <- NULL
  summary$run_id <- run_id
  expected <- nrow(grid) * length(slads_default_methods)
  if (nrow(summary) != expected || anyDuplicated(paste(summary$scenario, summary$method)))
    stop("Unexpected number of scenario/method results.")
  slads_write_csv(summary, file.path(directory, "summary.csv"))
  slads_stream_replicates(vapply(answer, `[[`, character(1), "checkpoint"), file.path(directory,
    "replicates.csv"))
  slads_write_csv(summary[summary$failed > 0L, , drop = FALSE], file.path(directory, "failed_cells.csv"))
  writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(directory, "sessionInfo.txt"))
  writeLines(c("Completed all requested repetitions. Inspect status/failed counts before using results.",
    paste("run_id:", run_id), paste("failed_method_evaluations:", sum(summary$failed))),
    file.path(directory, "COMPLETED.txt"))
  if (any(summary$failed > 0L))
    warning("Some methods failed: main rates/intervals are NA for these cells. See failed_cells.csv and replicates.csv.")
  list(summary = summary, config = config, directory = directory, workers = actual_workers)
}
```
